signals.title: Indian funds buying what foreign funds sell
signals.stat: Indian +1.4 pts, foreign −2.0 pts in a year
signals.text: Indian institutions are taking up what foreign funds sell: over the year domestic institutions rose to 21.7% (+1.4 pts) while foreign institutions fell to 16.7% (−2.0 pts). Over five years foreign institutions went from 27.7% to 16.7% and domestic institutions from 11.0% to 21.7%.

signals.title: Promoters raised their stake
signals.text: Promoters raised their stake to 50.4% from 50.0% over the year (+0.4 pts).

signals.title: Foreign funds selling
signals.text: Foreign institutions have cut their stake for 3 quarters in a row: 16.7% now against 18.7% a year ago.

signals.title: Indian funds buying
signals.text: Domestic institutions have added to their stake for 3 quarters in a row: 21.7% now against 20.3% a year ago.

signals.title: Foreign funds at 5-year low, Indian funds at high
signals.text: Foreign institutions' holding is the lowest, while domestic institutions' holding is the highest in five years.

signals.title: Shareholders up 15% in a year
signals.text: The number of shareholders rose 15% in a year, to 50.7 lakh.

signals.title: NPS Trust raised its stake
signals.text: NPS Trust raised its stake to 1.62% from 1.10%.

signals.title: Promoters hold just over half
signals.text: Promoters hold 50.4%, just over half of the company.
